details: Oil prices surged after renewed clashes between the United States and Iran in the strategic Strait of Hormuz on May 8, 2026. This escalation followed a period of volatile market sentiment, where earlier hopes for a peace deal had briefly lowered oil prices, but tensions quickly reversed with reports of exchanges of fire. The Strait remains a critical chokepoint for global oil and natural gas supplies, indicating ongoing geopolitical instability that directly impacts energy markets.
title: US-Iran Clashes Spark Oil Price Jump in Hormuz Strait

details: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has proposed new anti-money laundering (AML), countering the financing of terrorism (CFT), and sanctions obligations for payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act on May 7, 2026. These rules would require stablecoin issuers to have the capability to block transactions violating U.S. sanctions, even on secondary markets. Public comments on the proposed rule are due by June 9, 2026.
title: US Treasury Unveils New AML/CFT Rules for Stablecoins

details: Israeli authorities have charged two individuals, including an air force major, with bribery and security offenses, as reported on May 6, 2026. They are accused of using classified information to place bets on the timing of military operations, specifically strikes involving Iran and Israel, on crypto prediction markets such as Polymarket. Reports indicate these suspicious wagers generated significant profits based on non-public information.
title: Israelis Charged with Insider Trading on War Bets
